item.description: Which of the shop's lines. This counter takes fishing gear and fish, and nothing else.

quantity.description: How many were offered. What is actually sold comes back in the outcome.

main.description: Sell to the shop. What it pays falls as its shelf fills, and never goes under a tenth of what the item is worth. Selling more than is held sells what is held. Requires an atproto service auth token addressed to did:web:turtleme.at#turtle_game and naming this method, so a token issued for one call cannot be spent on another.
